post.text:
An older relative is a retired Hollywood producer. We were watching the original Harry Potter films, which adopted the entire book series in under 10 years. 

I asked him if it would be possible to do that now. I'll never forget his answer: "We can't. We don't know how." https://t.co/qqaJy1uDeP
